panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 5 panels (A, B, C, D, E). A: Clinical photo of patient's hands showing markedly shortened spatulate right thumb, captioned as such in FLNB mosaic Larsen syndrome case. B: Hand radiographs of same Larsen patient showing shortened right first distal phalanx radiographic correlate of spatulate thumb, plus distal phalangeal shortening. C: Real patient photo shows Larsen manifestations bilateral spatulate toes and calcaneovalgus deformity, but no vocabulary finding_key covers toes/foot deformity, so excluded per vocabulary rule. D: Radiograph shows wedge-shaped T4 vertebral body leading to thoracic scoliosis in Larsen patient, but vocabulary only includes cervical kyphosis, no thoracic finding, so no finding_key can be assigned. E: Pelvis radiograph shows narrow iliac wings, shortened femoral necks and coxa vara in Larsen patient, but no vocabulary key for these; no hip dislocation shown, so excluded.
